correctness.rationale: The cited theorem fixes the minimum at nine edges. An exact exhaustive verifier checks all 6,906,900 labeled nine-edge graphs using the equivalence between a newly created \(C_4\)/\(C_5\)/\(C_6\) and an existing endpoint path of length 3/4/5, yielding 100,800 solutions. Exact canonicalization gives six classes, and orbit-stabilizer reproduces the full labeled count.

originality.rationale: Final-claim searches by forbidden family, order, edge count, class count, and structural terminology found no exact or stronger coverage. The closest primary paper supplies the saturation number but not the located six-class order-eight classification; published-finding corpus matches concern non-equivalent problems.

value.rationale: The classification supplies the complete equality structure, explicit representatives, multiplicities, and automorphism orders at the first eight-vertex minimum layer of a newly solved saturation problem, giving a reproducible structural benchmark beyond the numerical extremal value.
